references.text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him.
Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even if these can forget, I will not forget you.
If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!
Do not be afraid, little flock, for it has pleased your Father to give you the kingdom.
